# Additional Practice for USACO Bronze

*Final tips for Bronze and additional practice problems.*

**Authors:** Nathan Wang

## What Now?

After completing this section on the USACO Guide, you should be comfortable with
the topics that have historically appeared in the USACO Bronze
division. (note: Of course, there's always a chance that another topic, potentially from a higher division, will show up in future Bronze contests.) In order to maximize your chance at promoting, you should
aim to **practice** by doing more problems.

## Uncategorized Problems

Below we list some problems that we think are roughly Bronze level but don't
really fit in previous modules. (note: either because there were too many problems already, or because the problem requires more than one concept) The difficulties listed here are relative to the Bronze
division (difficulty is subjective and isn't always accurate though). We'll be
expanding this list as we get more problem suggestions.

| --- | --- | --- |

## Final Thoughts

Refer to our FAQ to
[find more problems to practice](https://usaco.guide/general/usaco-faq#q-where-can-i-find-more-practice-problems).
You may also find the [How to Practice](https://usaco.guide/general/practicing)
module worth reading. Best of luck on future contests!
